title: Pause Before Responding
use: A message has made you angry and you need to respond.
output: A short pause plan, a factual opening, and a next step.
prompt: A project lead just blamed my team in Slack. Help me respond without escalating.

title: Perspective Check
use: You are treating your first interpretation as the whole story.
output: A facts-and-assumptions note with questions to test the gaps.
prompt: My colleague keeps challenging me in meetings. Help me check what I might be missing.

title: Listen Without Fixing
use: Someone needs to be heard before you jump to solutions.
output: A listening guide and an agreed support or action summary.
prompt: A team member says work feels impossible. Help me listen before offering advice.

title: Meaningful Recognition
use: You want to recognise a contribution without flattery or rewarding overwork.
output: A specific thank-you and a fair way to share credit.
prompt: Help me thank the people who rescued a difficult client handoff.

title: Compassionate Feedback
use: A specific behavior needs clear feedback and a chance to respond.
output: A factual opening, inquiry, and behavior-and-support agreement.
prompt: A senior designer interrupted two junior colleagues. Help me give clear feedback.

title: Difficult Conversation Rehearsal
use: You know what needs saying and want to practise before a real conversation.
output: A short role-play, practical feedback, and a revised opening.
prompt: Help me practise telling a project lead that their scope changes are exhausting the team.

title: Underperformance Support
use: Work is falling short and you need a fair support conversation.
output: An evidence note and a draft improvement-and-support plan.
prompt: Two deliverables were late. Help me discuss expectations and support fairly.

title: Conflict Navigation
use: People disagree repeatedly and the work is getting stuck.
output: A conflict map, an appropriate conversation route, and a working agreement.
prompt: Our delivery and sales leads keep fighting over client promises. Help us address it.

title: Repair After Harm
use: You caused harm and need to take responsibility and follow through.
output: An accountable apology and a concrete repair plan.
prompt: I dismissed a colleague's concern in front of the team. Help me repair that.

title: Workload and Boundaries
use: Overload or burnout concerns require a change to the work.
output: A capacity decision and a boundary agreement with owners.
prompt: Everyone is working evenings to meet client deadlines. Help me make a practical change.

title: Support Through Loss
use: A colleague is grieving and you need to offer practical, respectful support.
output: A first message, a work-cover plan, and an agreed contact plan.
prompt: A colleague's parent has died. What can I say and what should I arrange?

title: Return to Work Conversation
use: Someone is returning after an absence and needs a workable re-entry.
output: A collaborative return plan and a review of adjustments.
prompt: A colleague is returning after an extended absence. Help me plan the first conversation.

title: Voice and Safety
use: People are hesitant to raise concerns, admit mistakes, or disagree.
output: A safe input plan and a visible response-and-action loop.
prompt: People tell me privately that they disagree, but stay silent in meetings. Help me change that.

title: Working Agreements
use: Recurring friction needs clear expectations about how the team works.
output: A small set of testable team agreements with a review date.
prompt: Our hybrid team needs clearer agreements about response times and decisions.

title: Decision With Care
use: A consequential decision has real trade-offs for people and the business.
output: An options-and-impact brief with consultation and follow-through.
prompt: We may stop an unprofitable service. Help me examine the decision and its effect on people.

title: Change With People
use: A reorganisation, AI rollout, or new way of working needs honest involvement.
output: A change conversation, participation plan, and practical transition support.
prompt: We're introducing AI into delivery. Help me involve the team and explain what is open.

title: Dignified Exit Preparation
use: A human-led employment exit process needs careful preparation and communication.
output: A process-readiness brief and a conditional conversation draft.
prompt: Help me prepare a respectful exit conversation and check what must be confirmed first.

title: Team After Hard News
use: The team needs clarity and practical support after a loss, exit, or difficult announcement.
output: An honest team message, workload reset, and follow-up plan.
prompt: After a difficult departure, the team is worried and carrying extra work. Help me respond.

title: Workplace Pattern Review
use: The same human problem keeps returning despite good intentions.
output: A system hypothesis and a small, owned experiment.
prompt: Every project ends in last-minute overtime, even with different project leads. Help us find what repeats.

title: Leadership Retrospective
use: A difficult week or decision needs learning and follow-through.
output: A short reflection and one observable leadership commitment.
prompt: Help me review how I handled a difficult week and choose one thing to change.
